{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean the 'revenue' column: remove commas and convert to float
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Remove QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
filtered_data = data[data['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99].copy()

# Verify the removal
print("Number of QA orders removed:", len(data) - len(filtered_data))
print("New shape of data:", filtered_data.shape)

# Confirm no QA orders remain
print("Any QA orders left?", (filtered_data['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99).any())"}
